request.message: I have only a phone, laptop and a handmade clay cup. Explain what I will make across this course and what I need before beginning.

response.answer:
Lesson 01

AI Product Photoshoot & Ads has 8 lessons: 01 Course Intro; 02 Phone Photo Se Studio Photo (phone photos, Product Sheet, white studio/lifestyle/dark premium); 03 Model Ke Saath Product (character and product references, model shots and hands); 04 Festive Shoot + Colour Variants (Diwali, wedding scenes and a sheet for each colour); 05 ChatGPT Se Ad Plan (buyers, problems, angles, hooks, script, caption and Flow prompts); 06 Photo Se Product Video (one movement with Ingredients); 07 UGC-Style Video (honest phone-style AI-presenter videos); 08 Finale (complete workflow, common mistakes, honesty and final project). You learn to create product photos, product videos and honest ads for your own products or clients. You need a phone, laptop and a product. Tools: Google Flow, ChatGPT and CapCut; a full CapCut editing tutorial is not taught. Course prompts are in lesson notes.

Reviewed English translation: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads has 8 lessons: 01 Course Intro; 02 Phone Photo Se Studio Photo (phone photos, Product Sheet, white studio/lifestyle/dark premium); 03 Model Ke Saath Product (character and product references, model shots and hands); 04 Festive Shoot + Colour Variants (Diwali, wedding scenes and a sheet for each colour); 05 ChatGPT Se Ad Plan (buyers, problems, angles, hooks, script, caption and Flow prompts); 06 Photo Se Product Video (one movement with Ingredients); 07 UGC-Style Video (honest phone-style AI-presenter videos); 08 Finale (complete workflow, common mistakes, honesty and final project). You learn to create product photos, product videos and honest ads for your own products or clients. You need a phone, laptop and a product. Tools: Google Flow, ChatGPT and CapCut; a full CapCut editing tutorial is not taught. Course prompts are in lesson notes.

[S2] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — Lesson 01 — Course Intro (course-material) [Lesson 01; lesson_1]
Course Intro Course mein kya banega, tools, kya chahiye

[S3] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — chat G.P.T ne aisa feature likha jo (course-material) [Lesson 05; lesson_5]
chat G.P.T ne aisa feature likha jo Hata do. Prompt mein "use only the features I gave you" likho. (L05) product mein nahi
Reviewed English translation: Remove the unsupported feature. Tell the ad writer to use only the features you supplied and not invent anything new.

[S4] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — L07 UGC 2 (course-material) [Lesson 07; lesson_7]
Use the uploaded character sheet for the [woman] and the uploaded product sheet for the [PRODUCT]. Keep her face, hair and outfit exactly the same as the character sheet. Keep the [PRODUCT] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, no morphing. Vertical video shot from her own phone resting on the desk in front of her: the camera itself is the phone, so we see her and the [PRODUCT] from a low front angle. NO phone visible anywhere in the frame, no second camera, no screen facing us. She uses the [PRODUCT] for a moment, then looks up straight into the lens and talks, casual and natural. Natural window light, a real lived-in room, not a studio, not a polished ad. ONLY she speaks, one voice only, natural Hindi lip-sync, casual friendly tone. She says: "[your second line in Hindi]" real skin, no filter, clearly adult, modest, natural hands with five fingers, no text on screen, no watermark. Clean natural audio only — NO background music.

[S5] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — L06 Light Sweep (course-material) [Lesson 06; lesson_6]
Use the uploaded image as the first frame. The [PRODUCT] stays perfectly still and exactly the same the whole time — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, no morphing, no warping. The camera stays completely still. A soft band of warm light slowly sweeps across the [PRODUCT] from left to right, the shadows moving gently with it. Clean premium product video. No people, no hands, no text on screen. Soft quiet room ambience only — NO music, NO voice.

[S6] AI Product Photoshoot & Ads — Chatbot Transcript — UGC video mein phone dikh raha (course-material) [Lesson 07; lesson_7]
UGC video mein phone dikh raha "The camera itself is her phone. NO phone visible anywhere in the frame." (L07)
Reviewed English translation: Add the course FAQ instruction: “The camera itself is her phone. NO phone visible anywhere in the frame.”
